transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?
I'm here because I can't seem to stop fidgeting and tapping my hands and feet all the time. I'm constantly squirming in my seat, and it's getting really frustrating.
Do you also find yourself constantly worrying about a lot of different everyday things, or is this restlessness more of a physical need to keep moving?

It's definitely more of a physical need to keep moving rather than any kind of mental worry. I just constantly feel this overwhelming urge to fidget, tap my hands or feet, and squirm in my seat. It feels like my body just has to be in motion all the time.
Aside from the physical restlessness, do you also frequently struggle with paying attention, staying organized, or forgetting daily tasks?
I don't really struggle with those things, to be honest. My focus and organization are usually fine, and my main challenge is definitely just this constant physical restlessness.
